source.what: USGS / IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, Moon nomenclature centre points (ESRI point shapefile zip, MOON_nomenclature_center_pts), linked from https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/GIS_Downloads
source.longitude_conversion: lon = center_lon - 360 if center_lon > 180 else center_lon (east-positive, -180..180); the file value is kept as lon_0_360_as_in_file
source.latitude: center_lat, degrees, north positive (south negative), unchanged
source.feature_id: integer at the end of the record's link field (http://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/<id>)
source.name: clean_name column (ASCII form); the name column is kept as name_with_diacritics
source.values: lat, lon and diameter_km rounded to 6 decimals
